desc.en: A massive dragon that calmly swims along in the Dusk Sea. It has a very unique mode of life among dragons, and is leaps and bounds larger than other dragons. It has a relatively docile personality, and normally sleeps in the sand.
desc.ja: 黄昏の海を悠然と泳ぐ超大型の竜。他の竜とは異なった独自の生態を持っており、竜のなかでも飛びぬけて巨大。比較的おとなしい性格で、普段は砂中で眠っている
